svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Be prepared for job interviews by practicing coding questions. → Get a job.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Practice primarily on LeetCode because companies draw interview questions, or variations,
from it. → Be prepared for job interviews by practicing coding questions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Practice interview-popular questions from NeetCode's concise, categorized list. → Be prepa
red for job interviews by practicing coding questions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Practice coding questions daily while an interview is approaching. → Be prepared for job i
nterviews by practicing coding questions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Look up and practice the exact question a friend shares by its LeetCode number, so they ca
n discuss the same problem and he is better prepared. → Be prepared for job interviews by
practicing coding questions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Track the number of completed questions to see improvement and gain confidence for intervi
ews. → Be prepared for job interviews by practicing coding questions.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Consult GeeksforGeeks for step-by-step algorithm walkthroughs and more examples when LeetC
ode's explanations are unclear. → Turn to the solution after about an hour of unsuccessful
effort, then spend about an hour understanding and re-implementing it.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Practice more on a question category after exceeding the target time, so he can do better
next time. → Target about 20–30 minutes for medium questions and 20–40 minutes for hard qu
estions, with about 10 minutes for easy ones.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Reserve a large, uninterrupted block of time for patient, distraction-free practice. → Pra
ctice coding questions daily while an interview is approaching.
